author: PokerFace
body:
Hi everyone,

So I saw the "Tournament Prediction" thread and, I thought of an idea that would really bring the community some people and fun. 

How it would work is:

Players are allowed to gamble their credits they earn in game. Of course, we don't want people earning a million credits so, the return rate has to be slightly smaller.

Some things that can be gambled on is:

-Number of monuments mined (both teams)
-Which team will win?
-Which team will get more kills?
-Which team will have more deaths?
-YOUR IDEAS

Minimum and maximum:

Minimum: 100 credits*
Maximum: 5000 credits*

*subject to change

Notes:
-Keep in mind that some teams are obviously better than the other so, the return rate for the "obvious" winner should be significantly reduced. 

-Members who aren't donors will have a different chance to earn more credits. 

-Refunds should be given for ties unless, you are allowed to predict a "tie" option. Selecting the tie option should give you a bigger bonus.

Anyways, thanks for reading. Feedback is appreciated. 

(I would want to gamble my credits with my "PokerFace" haha)
